overview: The subcommittee amended and referred a policy governing legal counsel and began reviewing a proposed permissive student dress code modeled after other districts.

items.title: School Attorney Policy
items.summary: Referred the policy to the full committee after amending language to require the superintendent to seek authorization for legal expenses exceeding the budgeted retainer.

items.title: Dress Code Policy
items.summary: Continued the discussion to a future meeting to allow administrators to review enforcement language and ensure the draft effectively balances student expression with school safety.
